When introducing themselves, the members introduce their native states (Gujarat, Maharashtra, Punjab, etc.) rather than saying they are Indian. This upsets the Colonel, who feels they lack national unity and prepares to leave. Tapu Sena convinces him to stay and watch the program.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
